delta <- 4.3                # Expected difference in means (dBA)
sd_common <- 7.8            # Common standard deviation (dBA)
alpha <- 0.05               # Significance level
sidedness <- "one.sided"    # One-sided test

# Calculate effect size (Cohen's d)
cohens_d <- delta / sd_common

# Calculate degrees of freedom
df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2

# Calculate critical t-value for one-sided test at alpha = 0.05
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df, lower.tail = TRUE)

# Calculate non-centrality parameter

library(stats)

# Fixed seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)

# Study parameters
n_per_group <- 32
delta <- 4.3
sigma <- 7.8
alpha <- 0.05
n_simulations <- 10000

cat("MONTE CARLO VALIDATION (10,000 simulations)\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse=""), "\n\n")

# Pre-allocate results
reject_H0 <- numeric(n_simulations)

# Run simulations
for (i in 1:n_simulations) {
  # Generate data under H1 (true difference = delta)
  group1 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = delta, sd = sigma)
  group2 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  
  # Conduct pooled t-test (one-sided, greater)
  t_result <- t.test(group1, group2, 
                     alternative = "greater",
                     var.equal = TRUE)
  
  # Record rejection (p-value < alpha)
  reject_H0[i] <- (t_result$p.value < alpha)
}

# Compute empirical power
empirical_power <- mean(reject_H0)
mc_se <- sqrt(empirical_power * (1 - empirical_power) / n_simulations)

cat(sprintf("Empirical Power (from simulation): %.6f\n", empirical_power))
cat(sprintf("Monte Carlo Standard Error: %.6f\n", mc_se))
cat(sprintf("95%% Confidence Interval: [%.6f, %.6f]\n\n", 
            empirical_power - 1.96*mc_se, 
            empirical_power + 1.96*mc_se))

# Analytical power
t_critical <- qt(1 - alpha, 62)
SE <- sigma * sqrt(2 / n_per_group)
ncp <- delta / SE
analytical_power <- 1 - pt(t_critical, 62, ncp = ncp)

cat(sprintf("Analytical Power: %.6f\n", analytical_power))
cat(sprintf("Difference (empirical - analytical): %.6f\n", empirical_power - analytical_power))
cat(sprintf("Difference relative to MC_SE: %.3f standard errors\n\n", 
            (empirical_power - analytical_power) / mc_se))

# Assess agreement
if (abs(empirical_power - analytical_power) <= 1.96 * mc_se) {
  cat("AGREEMENT: Analytical result is consistent with Monte Carlo simulation\n")
} else {
  cat("CAUTION: Analytical and empirical results differ by more than 1.96*SE\n")
}

# JSON output

  list(results = list(list(metric = "power", value = analytical_power, unit = "probability")),
       simulation = list(seed = 12345, trials = n_simulations,

                        ci_lower = empirical_power - 1.96*mc_se,
                        ci_upper = empirical_power + 1.96*mc_se)),

)

  group1 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  group2 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0, sd = sigma)

  reject_H0_true[i] <- (t_result$p.value < alpha)

}

sigma <- 7.8
alpha <- 0.05

cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse=""), "\n\n")

# Pre-allocate results
reject_H0 <- numeric(n_simulations)

# Run simulations
for (i in 1:n_simulations) {
  # Generate data under H1 (true difference = delta)
  group1 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = delta, sd = sigma)
  group2 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  
  # Conduct pooled t-test (one-sided, greater)
  t_result <- t.test(group1, group2, 
                     alternative = "greater",
                     var.equal = TRUE)
  
  # Record rejection (p-value < alpha)
  reject_H0[i] <- (t_result$p.value < alpha)
}

# Compute empirical power
empirical_power <- mean(reject_H0)
mc_se <- sqrt(empirical_power * (1 - empirical_power) / n_simulations)

cat(sprintf("Empirical Power (from simulation): %.6f\n", empirical_power))
cat(sprintf("Monte Carlo Standard Error: %.6f\n", mc_se))
cat(sprintf("95%% Confidence Interval: [%.6f, %.6f]\n\n",
